mcq.question: In Model-View-Presenter, which part decides whether the Convert button is enabled?
mcq.explanation: The view only displays what it is told and forwards events. The presenter holds the UI rules, which is why it can be tested without any widgets.

mcq.question: What makes it possible to test the converter without opening a window?

options.A: The tests run the GUI in a hidden window
options.B: The presenter depends only on the `ConverterView` interface, so tests can pass a fake view
options.C: The model contains all the UI logic
options.D: Qt provides a headless mode that the tests use

mcq.explanation: Depending on an interface instead of concrete widgets lets the tests substitute a fake that records what the presenter asked it to show.
